text.title: Program Dependency Aging Chart Recipe — Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the weekly dependency aging chart artefact: the program PM as owner, the chart date on the checkpoint weekday with the tracker query and extraction timestamp, the age bands fixed at adoption, one edge per typed dependency with producer, consumer, type, `opened_at`, `needed_by`, tracker link id, blocked-task count, age in days from `opened_at`, band, slack, `superseded_from` for re-ticketed edges and an owned, dated action from the second band or non-positive slack onward (a re-baseline decision in the top band), the action table sorted red-first then band then blocked count, the resolved log, and the 85th-percentile SLE. Validator in scripts/validate-program-dependency-aging-chart-recipe.py enforces it, including the age, slack, sort and SLE arithmetic.

required.field: the named program PM who takes re-baseline decisions, `role:handle` (03 human checkpoint)
the date the chart is drawn for; ages and slack are computed against it (r-age-from-dependency-open-not-task, r-milestone-slack-column)
the weekday of the weekly checkpoint; `chart_date` falls on it (r-weekly-refresh-by-script)
the tracker query the script ran to extract the edges (r-weekly-refresh-by-script)
when the script ran; within the checkpoint week, not after `chart_date` (r-weekly-refresh-by-script)
ordered, contiguous calendar-day bands starting at 0 with an open top band, fixed at `bands_adopted_on`; default 0-7, 8-14, 15-28, over 28 (r-age-bands-fixed)
the date the bands were set; they do not change afterwards (r-age-bands-fixed)

one entry per open dependency edge from the graph: `link_id`, `producer_team`, `consumer_team`, `dependency_type`, `opened_at`, `needed_by` (null = `no-deadline`), `blocked_task_count`, `age_days`, `band`, `slack_days`, optional `superseded_from`, `action` from the second band or non-positive slack, `rebaseline` in the top band (r-typed-edges-from-graph, r-count-blocked-tasks-per-edge, r-milestone-slack-column, r-action-per-escalation-band, r-no-aging-reset)
`link_id`s in display order: non-positive slack first, then band descending, then `blocked_task_count` descending (r-count-blocked-tasks-per-edge, r-milestone-slack-column)
delivered or not-needed edges with `opened_at`, `resolved_on`, `age_days`, `outcome`; `not-needed` only for edges that had a `needed_by` (r-closed-edges-feed-sle, r-typed-edges-from-graph)
`resolved_count_12w` over the trailing 12 weeks; `status` = `line` with `p85_days` when at least 10 resolved, else `insufficient-data` (r-closed-edges-feed-sle)
path or URL of the script-generated image embedded in the checkpoint slide (r-weekly-refresh-by-script)

forbidden.pattern: `age_days` smaller than `chart_date` minus `opened_at` — the clock ran from a comment, a status change or the task, not the edge — fm-01
an edge without `producer_team`, `consumer_team`, `dependency_type`, `opened_at` or `link_id`, or a `not-needed` outcome on an edge that never had `needed_by` — fm-02
`age_bands` that do not start at 0, are not contiguous, or have a closed top band — fm-03
a `superseded_from` edge whose `opened_at` is later than the original's, or a resolved entry reopened within 14 days still in `resolved_log` — fm-04
an edge in the second band or older, or with non-positive slack, whose `action` is missing, has no owner or `due_date`, or reads "waiting on" — fm-05
an edge with `slack_days` at or below 0 not at the top of `action_table` — fm-06
`extracted_at` more than 7 days before `chart_date`, after it, or missing `tracker_query` — fm-07
`sle.status: line` with fewer than 10 resolved edges, or a `p85_days` that is not the 85th percentile of the trailing-12-week resolved ages — r-closed-edges-feed-sle

list.item: Every `age_days` equals `chart_date` minus `opened_at` in calendar days, and `band` is the band that range falls in (r-age-from-dependency-open-not-task, r-age-bands-fixed).
Every edge carries producer, consumer, type, `opened_at`, `needed_by` (or null) and a tracker `link_id`; nothing from a standup is plotted without one (r-typed-edges-from-graph).
`age_bands` start at 0, are contiguous, end in an open band, and equal the bands recorded at `bands_adopted_on` (r-age-bands-fixed).

`slack_days` equals `needed_by` minus `chart_date`; edges at or below 0 head `action_table`, then band descending, then `blocked_task_count` descending (r-milestone-slack-column, r-count-blocked-tasks-per-edge).
`extracted_at` is within 7 days before `chart_date`, `chart_date` is on `checkpoint_weekday`, and `tracker_query` is recorded (r-weekly-refresh-by-script).

Every edge in the second band or older, or with non-positive slack, has an `action` with owner, due date and a verb, not "waiting on"; every top-band edge has a `rebaseline` decided by `owner` (r-action-per-escalation-band).
A `superseded_from` edge keeps the original `opened_at`; a resolved entry reopened within 14 days is not in `resolved_log` (r-no-aging-reset).
`sle.resolved_count_12w` counts `resolved_log` entries within 12 weeks of `chart_date`; `p85_days` is their 85th percentile when at least 10, otherwise `insufficient-data` (r-closed-edges-feed-sle).
